Sandy will call or text you to confirm the visit before you arrive.

What happens next

  1. Sandy confirms the visit and answers any questions.
  2. Your 15-minute visit is in normal clothes. There is no workout. Sandy schedules the coached first class afterward.
  3. Check the current schedule and studio directions before your visit.
